snippet.title: EXODUS Official Release Date Trailer | gamescom ONL 2026
snippet.description:
Step Forward. Your EXODUS begins April 7, 2027. Wishlist Now: http://exodus.game/uh0

Watch Jun Aslan, salvager turned Traveler, join forces with Salt, an Awakened octopus companion who’s as deadly as she is intelligent. A mercenary and bounty hunter, she hasn’t needed anyone… until now. Her will to survive matches Jun’s own, and together, they’ll have to fight to save the one thing worth going back to: home. 

Different species, same fight. And countless ways this could go sideways.


ABOUT EXODUS™
EXODUS is a cinematic single-player action RPG set in a new, far-future sci-fi universe.  You are Jun Aslan. Rise from salvager to Traveler and fight for the future of your homeworld. Discover new worlds ravaged by the effects of time, blast your way past hostile Celestial enemies and rival human factions, and recover powerful Remnants to reshape your civilization. Discover your destiny and lead a crew of unforgettable companions as you search for the key to humanity’s survival across the most dangerous reaches of space.

The game is developed by Archetype Entertainment, a studio founded by award-winning RPG veterans behind Mass Effect, Baldur's Gate, and STAR WARS: Knights of the Old Republic, and published by Wizards of the Coast.

EXODUS launches April 7, 2027, on Steam, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X/S, and the Epic Games Store.
